description: This file contains the implementation of a jQuery plugin called TableDnD, which enables drag-and-drop reordering of table rows with configurable options and support for touch devices.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the drag-and-drop functionality on selected tables with optional configuration.

methods.name: makeIndented
methods.description: Prepares hierarchical indentation for table rows based on data-level attributes.

methods.name: makeDraggable
methods.description: Makes table rows draggable, optionally using a specified drag handle.

methods.name: currentOrder
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current order of rows in the table.

methods.name: initialiseDrag
methods.description: Begins the drag operation for a specific row.

methods.name: updateTables
methods.description: Reapplies draggable behavior to tables, useful after dynamic content updates.

methods.name: mouseCoords
methods.description: Gets the mouse coordinates from an event, accounting for browser differences.

methods.name: getMouseOffset
methods.description: Calculates the mouse offset relative to a target element.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element in the document.

methods.name: autoScroll
methods.description: Automatically scrolls the window when the mouse is near the top or bottom during drag.

methods.name: moveVerticle
methods.description: Moves the dragged row vertically based on drag direction.

methods.name: moveHorizontal
methods.description: Moves the row horizontally to support hierarchy levels.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Handles the mouse move event during dragging, updating row position and auto-scrolling.

methods.name: findDragDirection
methods.description: Determines the direction of drag movement (horizontal and vertical).

methods.name: findDropTargetRow
methods.description: Finds the target row where the dragged row will be dropped.

methods.name: processMouseup
methods.description: Completes the drag operation, updates row order, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Handles the mouse up event to finalize dragging.

methods.name: jsonize
methods.description: Serializes the table data into JSON format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the table data into URL-encoded string.

methods.name: serializeTable
methods.description: Serializes a specific table's row IDs into URL-encoded string.

methods.name: serializeTables
methods.description: Serializes all tables' data into URL-encoded strings.

methods.name: tableData
methods.description: Returns structured data representing the table's row hierarchy and IDs.
